question: what are dr cassidy's office hours this semester and where is her office? i want to ask her about doing an independent study in philosophy
answer:
Lisa M. Cassidy is an Associate Professor of Philosophy in the School of Arts, Humanities, and Education. Her listed office hours are “Office Hours: T 8:45-9:45 am, 1:30-3:30 pm”; her office is B-209. You can email her at lcassidy@ramapo.edu. [5]

For independent study, the catalog lists PHIL 100, PHIL 200 and PHIL 300, each 4 credits, with no published prerequisites. [2][3][4] Limited opportunities are available. To register: (1) choose a topic not covered in the standard curriculum; topics in it may be explored under extraordinary circumstances, and you may not study a course offered in the regular schedule that semester. [7] (2) Obtain an Independent Study Registration Form from the Registrar; have the instructor and sponsoring school dean complete it; return it to the Registrar’s Office. [8][9] (3) Complete a contract form specifying purpose, objective, grading criteria, work-hour guidelines, discipline and level, and title/credits. [8][9] Submit by the last day of add/drop; registrations are not accepted after that. [8][9] Undergraduates may take no more than 4 independent-study credits in a semester, including summer or winter, and normally no more than 8 over their college career; students on academic probation or warning need the Dean’s permission. [9]

The Registrar’s contact is reg@ramapo.edu, (201) 684-7695. [9]

Sources: [2](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/courses/PHIL100) [3](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/courses/PHIL200) [4](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/courses/PHIL300) [5](https://www.ramapo.edu/ahe/faculty/lisa-m-cassidy/) [7](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/pages/R532kjMfIcfnIkM0srb3#independent-study1) [8](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/pages/R532kjMfIcfnIkM0srb3#independent-study1) [9](https://www.ramapo.edu/registrar/registrationinfo/)
